approved: COVID-19 Response Commission of Inquiry Bill 2024
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would create a commission of inquiry into Australia's handling of the COVID-19 pandemic.
The commission would investigate federal, state and territory government responses and report to Parliament within 18 months.
The commission would have powers to summon witnesses, issue search warrants and arrest people who fail to appear.
Establishes the Covid-19 Response Commission of Inquiry.
Requires the commission to report to Parliament within 18 months, unless the Senate extends the period.
Gives the commission powers to summon witnesses, issue search warrants and arrest non-attending witnesses.
The governments of the Commonwealth, States and Territories, and people who may be summoned as witnesses.
